official.deadline_note: Applicants to Universiti Brunei Darussalam must in addition complete UBD's own online admission application (apply.ubd.edu.bn) and applicants to Universiti Teknologi Brunei must apply via apply.utb.edu.bn, so the universities' own admission timelines run in parallel with the BDGS closing date.
official.status_note: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced that applications for the 2026/2027 session would open on 15 December 2025, with the closing date for applications 15 February 2026; the MFA Katalyst applicant portal (BDGS-V3) now displays 'This application is now closed. Thank you for your interest.'
official.tuition_coverage_note: Exemption from paying tuition fees including acceptance, examination, registration and orientation fees for the duration of the programme.
benefits: Exemption from paying tuition fees including acceptance, examination, registration and orientation fees for the duration of the programme
An economy class air-ticket to Brunei Darussalam from the recipient's country of origin/country of domicile before the course starts and an economy class air-ticket back upon completion of the course
A monthly personal allowance of BND$500.00
A monthly meals allowance of BND$150.00
An annual book allowance of BND$600.00
Accommodation at the residential college of the University/Polytechnic
Baggage allowance for shipment of personal effects on completion, at a maximum of BND$250.00 to a country within the ASEAN region or BND$500.00 to a country outside the ASEAN region
Comprehensive insurance cover for the whole duration of the scholarship
Complementary medical treatment at any Brunei Government hospital (as published by Universiti Brunei Darussalam on the BDGS scheme)
eligibility: Applications are open to citizens of, but not limited to, ASEAN, Commonwealth and OIC member countries

Applicants must not exceed the age of 25 for Undergraduate and Diploma programmes, and the age of 35 for Postgraduate Master's Degree programmes, on the first day of July of the year the course/programme starts
Bruneians, Brunei Permanent Residents and international students studying/who have studied in Brunei tertiary institutions are NOT eligible
The scholarship is intended primarily for international students studying for the first time in Brunei Darussalam

Study is tenable at Diploma, Undergraduate Degree and Postgraduate Master's Degree level at Universiti Brunei Darussalam (UBD), Universiti Islam Sultan Sharif Ali (UNISSA), Universiti Teknologi Brunei (UTB), Kolej Universiti Perguruan Ugama Seri Begawan (KUPU SB) and Politeknik Brunei (PB)
requirements: Complete the online BDGS application form within the application window
Meet the published English proficiency requirement
Applicants applying to Universiti Brunei Darussalam must also complete an online application through apply.ubd.edu.bn
Applicants applying to Universiti Teknologi Brunei must also complete an online application through apply.utb.edu.bn
An applicant may be required to appear for an interview and to sit a written examination to assess proficiency in English/Malay/Arabic (where applicable)
The scholarship may not be held concurrently with any other scholarship, fellowship, grant or loan without prior written approval of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
documents: Certified true copies of academic qualifications and other supporting documents (certificates, testimonials, transcripts)
Certified English translations of supporting documents that are not in English
Certified true copies of Birth Certificate and Passport
References and recommendations from referees (C1 and C2 forms)
selection_criteria: Applications are reviewed under the annual BDGS announcement issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
An applicant may be required to appear for an interview at places determined by the institutions offering the programmes, and to sit a written examination in English/Malay/Arabic (where applicable)
The Government of Brunei Darussalam reserves the right to reject any applications; the decision on the selection of candidates is final and will not be entertained
Successful applicants will be contacted/notified for further consideration in the selection process; unsuccessful applicants will be notified through email
coverage: Tuition fees (including acceptance, examination, registration and orientation fees) at the host institution for the duration of the programme
Accommodation at the residential college of the University/Polytechnic
Economy class air tickets to Brunei Darussalam before the course and back to the country of origin/domicile upon completion
Shipment of personal effects on completion (up to BND$250 within ASEAN, up to BND$500 outside ASEAN)
Comprehensive insurance for the whole duration of the scholarship
Complementary medical treatment at any Brunei Darussalam government hospital
application_method: Apply online through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs BDGS applicant portal during the annual application window
Upload identification cards, certified true copies of academic qualifications, certified English translations, certified copies of birth certificate and passport, and C1/C2 referee references
Applicants to UBD also complete the UBD online admission application; applicants to UTB also complete the UTB online admission application
Attend an interview and/or sit the language examination if called
Sign a declaration confirming understanding and agreement to the terms and conditions upon acceptance of the award
official.application_route: Apply online through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs BDGS applicant portal (Katalyst) during the annual window of roughly 15 December to 15 February, and separately complete the host university's own online admission application where required (UBD, UTB).
official.duration: For the duration of the programme; tuition exemption and allowances apply for the duration of the programme
official.description: The Government of Brunei Darussalam Scholarship for Foreign Students Tenable in Brunei Darussalam (BDGS) is the Government of Brunei Darussalam's scheme for foreign students to pursue Diploma, Undergraduate Degree and Postgraduate Master's Degree study at Brunei's higher education institutions, administered by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs with a full package covering tuition, allowances, accommodation, travel and insurance.
official.english_requirement: Proficient in English with a Credit 6 at GCE 'O' Level Examination, or a Grade C in IGCSE English (as a second language), or an IELTS score of 6.0, or a TOEFL minimum score of 550
official.citizenship_residency: Open to citizens of, but not limited to, ASEAN, Commonwealth and OIC member countries. The award is not eligible to Brunei Darussalam Permanent Residents; Bruneians, Brunei Permanent Residents and international students studying/who have studied in Brunei tertiary institutions are NOT eligible.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the scheme is specifically for foreign (international) students; Bruneians, Brunei Permanent Residents and international students studying or who have studied in Brunei tertiary institutions are not eligible

applicant_utility.summary: BDGS is Brunei's government-funded route for first-time international students to Diploma, Bachelor's or Master's study at UBD, UNISSA, UTB, KUPU SB or Politeknik Brunei, pairing full tuition exemption with a BND$500 monthly personal allowance, BND$150 monthly meals allowance, BND$600 annual book allowance, residential-college accommodation, economy air tickets and comprehensive insurance. The 2026/2027 round opened on 15 December 2025 and closed on 15 February 2026, with the MFA portal now shut, so the realistic target is the next annual round (typically opening mid-December with a mid-February deadline). Beyond the scholarship form, UBD and UTB applicants must also submit the university's own admission application, which is where many candidates lose time.
applicant_utility.best_fit: School leavers and early-career applicants (25 or under for undergraduate/diploma, 35 or under for Master's) from ASEAN, Commonwealth or OIC countries seeking a fully funded English-medium degree in Brunei who have never studied at a Bruneian tertiary institution.
application_readiness_checklist: Diarise the window: the scheme has run on a roughly 15 December to 15 February cycle, so prepare documents before the portal opens
Obtain certified true copies (not plain photocopies) of every certificate, transcript and testimonial
Have certified English translations ready for any document not issued in English
Line up two referees willing to complete the C1/C2 reference forms
Secure English evidence early: GCE 'O' Level Credit 6, IGCSE English-as-second-language Grade C, IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 550
If targeting UBD or UTB, complete the university's separate online admission application in parallel rather than after the BDGS submission
common_rejection_risks: Being a Brunei Permanent Resident, or having studied at any Brunei tertiary institution - both are explicit exclusions
Age cut-off is measured on 1 July of the year the course starts, not at application, so late-year birthdays can push applicants over 25/35
Holding another scholarship, fellowship, grant or loan without prior written MFA approval can void or revoke the award
Submitting only the BDGS form without the mandatory separate UBD (or UTB) admission application
Uncertified photocopies or missing English translations of supporting documents
Assuming a rejection email will not come - unsuccessful applicants are notified by email, so keep the registered mailbox monitored
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The scheme urges recipients to obtain additional (top-up) insurance before travelling and for the duration of the stay at their own expense, and it provides no marriage, child or family allowances and no accommodation for accompanying dependants; other personal costs are not listed among the covered items.
document_audit: Certification means certified true copies - a plain scan of an original will not satisfy the requirement
Every non-English document needs its own certified English translation, including transcripts and testimonials
Birth certificate and passport must both be submitted as certified true copies, alongside identification cards
Referee references use the prescribed C1/C2 forms, so brief referees on the format before the window closes
alerts: The window is short - roughly two months between the mid-December opening and the 15 February closing date - and there is no evidence of late acceptance
The selection decision is final and enquiries about it will not be entertained; only successful applicants are contacted for further consideration
Recipients must leave Brunei Darussalam with immediate effect upon completion of the programme - the award carries no stay-on entitlement
No paid employment or work for any country's representative mission in Brunei is permitted during the scholarship, so budget for living costs within the allowances
Health screening in Brunei may be required if the Ministry deems it necessary
For those who miss the window: PhD study at UBD is not covered by BDGS - it falls under the UBD Graduate Research Scholarship instead
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Complete the MFA's online BDGS application form with certified documents uploaded, file the separate UBD/UTB admission application where relevant, then wait for interview/examination call-ups and email notification of the outcome.
